note: Catalog entries for the Florida Part A subjects. tools/install_florida.py appends these to content/catalog.json. Ids match tools/lecturelib/taxonomies/florida.json so lecture links work automatically.

exam.name: Florida Bar Exam, Part A
exam.note: Florida's General Bar Examination pairs Part A (Florida law: essays and multiple choice) with Part B (the MBE). Confirm the current format with the Florida Board of Bar Examiners.

subjects.name: Florida Civil Procedure
subjects.blurb: The Florida Rules of Civil and General Practice and Judicial Administration: service, pleadings, discovery, summary judgment, proposals for settlement and appeals.

subjects.name: Florida Constitutional Law
subjects.blurb: The Florida Constitution: the Declaration of Rights, the three branches, Article V courts, local government and amendment.

subjects.name: Business Entities (Florida)
subjects.blurb: Florida corporations, LLCs and partnerships, plus agency: formation, fiduciary duties, liability and dissolution.

subjects.name: Florida Wills & Estates
subjects.blurb: The Florida Probate Code: intestacy, execution and revocation, elective share, pretermitted heirs, homestead, and estate administration.

subjects.name: Florida Trusts
subjects.blurb: The Florida Trust Code: creation, revocable trusts, trustee duties, spendthrift and creditor rules, modification and termination.

subjects.name: Florida Family Law
subjects.blurb: Chapter 61 dissolution, equitable distribution, alimony, parenting plans, child support and relocation, plus Chapter 39 dependency.

subjects.name: Florida Evidence
subjects.blurb: The Florida Evidence Code (Chapter 90) and where it departs from the Federal Rules.

subjects.name: Florida Criminal Law & Procedure
subjects.blurb: Florida crimes and defenses, constitutional criminal procedure, and the Florida Rules of Criminal Procedure.

subjects.name: Florida Real Property
subjects.blurb: Homestead, conveyancing and recording, residential landlord-tenant law, mortgages and foreclosure, and ownership.

subjects.name: Florida Torts
subjects.blurb: Florida negligence and comparative fault, Florida-specific liability doctrines, sovereign immunity, limitations and damages.

subjects.name: UCC Articles 3 & 9
subjects.blurb: Negotiable instruments and secured transactions as tested on Florida Part A.

subjects.name: Florida Professional Responsibility
subjects.blurb: The Rules Regulating The Florida Bar: fees, trust accounts, confidentiality, conflicts, advertising and discipline.
